purpose: Make actual pixels, overlays and multi-state renders first-class agent evidence rather than backend-only assertions.
inspectionRules: Actual committed pixels are required for a visual PASS.
Owner-drawn linework must remain visible in an overlay artifact when checking anatomical registration.
Numerical receipts cannot override a visual regression.
A still cannot prove a motion claim; motion requires a multi-state sequence.
Protected eyes, nostrils and mouth must be compared before and after any upstream rig output is adopted.
Source and authority hashes must match the current committed inputs.
